lines.en: I decide to spend the night wandering around in hopes of maybe bumping into Yumi or something since that’s how things always used to work before the world went to shit.
Or I guess closer to shit than it already was since I have ultimately uncovered the fact that my life has always been pretty fucking terrible.
And that really makes me question why I stopped suppressing things in the first place when not doing that really just makes me feel worse.
I get that I’m probably supposed to use this as fuel to recover and “become a better person” or something but, let’s face it, that’s not going to happen.
Because not only do I lack the strength to do so — I possess a critical weakness in being so easily infatuated by anyone who shows me affection that I have no choice but to fall for them.
And there comes a point in falling where it’s just fucking annoying.
Just let me hit the ground already and save myself from this seemingly unending story that I can only imagine exhausts you just as much as it does me.
I guess that’ll have to wait, though — as I have now bumped not into Yumi, but the one Yumi-adjacent being that I have put my penis inside of. Weirdly enough.
: Thank you, human customer person! We apologize that you will need to go further away to find the yellow spheres of your sourest desires!
: Kaori? Nao? What are you doing here?
: Ah! Sexfriend!
: Please don’t call me that in public.
: Then, regular Friend! The Nao-chan and I have decided to open a lemon-assistance stand!
: A lemon...assistance stand?
: Correct! To aid humans in the retrieval of lemons!
: Oh, I think I see what happened here. But that’s not even the right spelling of-
: Three blocks west! Two blocks straight! Go, go, go! Let your sourest dreams run wild!
: Nothing good ever comes from letting my dreams run wild, so I’ll just hang out here for a little bit and and try to figure out why this is your latest business venture.
: There are no works to work on this night! Let alone works that would work the Nao-chan! So I am teaching her the ins and outs of produce distribution!
: Unfortunately, there is an evil human organization known only as the “Produce Delivery Administration” that appears to have a Sorry! on the distribution of the lemonfruit.
: Wrong board game, Kaori.
: I am very Monopoly for the mistake, Friend. I am doing my best.
: Are you really, though?
: Reverse-no! That is precisely why we have obtained the other fruits that we are legally authorized to sell!
: Unfortunately, however, most of the customers who have come here have only been interested in lemons. With the exception of a sole duck who inquired about the purchasing of grapes.
: Staying true to our name, though, we offer free guidance to the nearest lemonfruit vendor in exchange for only 100 yen!
: That...is not “free” guidance, Kaori.
: All guidance is free in America, Friendburger.
: This is Japan.
: Land of the brave. Home of the sour.
: Kaori-
: Name a fruit and we will help you find it! Or don’t! But please do! Aunt Yuki needs the money!
: Yuki? You mean you’re-
: Helping her become healed. She is currently in the process of dying, and it is my understanding that we can clear the black clouds above her with legal tendies.
: Legal tender. Just say money.
: Legal boneless buffalo wings. I understand perfectly.
: Ugh! This shit is getting impossible to keep up with and I am GOSH DARN tired of it!!!
This is Connor. He's in charge of maintaining continuity in the world and only shows up when there are certain mistakes that would take way too long to fix otherwise.
He will now explain to you why he is here and why you have to look at him.
: Okay. So, for some reason, you've decided to play the game like a fucking LOSER and avoid boning certain cartoons because their cartoon age is lower than that of the other cartoons.
: And chances are you'll encounter more in the future since writing branching narratives is hard as FUCK and Selebus straight up forgets you exist sometimes.
: Anyway, if you were playing the game correctly and leading the protagonist down his rightfully wrongful path of debauchery, you'd have learned by now that HE learned that Yuki is okay. Kind of.
: In the proper route, Sensei goes to Tsukioka manor and finds all of this information out before a bunch of chairs show up and some girls take notes on penises and other penis-adjacent content.
: So go ahead and just pretend he knows that now and save the creator some time. Thanks!
Connor begins to bash his Hammer of Correction against the screen and all is suddenly good and there are no more continuity issues. Go play the wizard route.
: Kaori, this is a...very nice thing you’re doing. And I’m sure Yuki would greatly appreciate it. But I don’t think she needs the money anymore.
: SHE ALREADY DIED?! THAT WAS SO FAST!
: No, no. She did not die. She just found someone with a lot of money who’s willing to take care of her until she gets better.
: This is information you should have immediately provided without giving me the opportunity to gasp!
: I’m kind of surprised she didn’t tell you if you were already in the loop about this. I can fill in some of the details, but...maybe without Nao present?
: Nao-chan says, “What the frick, man?”
: She’s just too young to hear about death and stuff and I have a pre-existing disposition toward this because of things that have happened to the small human I raised.
: Then, would it not be better for her to learn about these concepts before she is ultimately forced to experience them and subsequently thrown into traumatic shock?
: Nope. That makes too much sense for a horrible parent like me.
: I understand. In that case, Nao-chan, please give us a moment and go hand out the sour information notes to those who pass our fruit-shelter.
: What’d she say that time?
: Something about your input being somehow less valuable than the items that we are peddling.
: This time, she says “Baaaaaaaaaka.”
Nao hurries off and starts handing out what I can only imagine is some sort of flier to anyone who passes by, giving me an opportunity to figure out just how much Kaori knows and...understands.
: Does being alone mean that you are going to do the sex to me again?
I don’t think she understands much.
: This is probably not the time for that. We’re kind of in the middle of something, remember?
: I’m Monopoly again. I don’t have much sexperience, so I don’t know how this goes.
: Kaori, how much do you know about Yuki’s situation? Because it’s clearly enough to start trying to raise money for her, but...do you understand how serious this predicament is?
: Very serious if it can make Aunt Yukiburger cry. I had assumed her tear production facility went out of service before I even became the Queen of Spiders.
: Who is this person she has found with seemingly deep pockets? Are they deep enough to fit a horse?
: If you mean buy a horse, yes. Tsubasa has several horses, I imagine.
: Tsubasa?!
: Do you...know her somehow too?
: No!
: Then...what is this reaction, exactly?
: Monopoly three. I thought I was supposed to act surprised. I do not typically receive good news.
: Well, yeah. It’s good news for sure. But this doesn’t mean she is out of the weeds yet, if you know what I mean.
: It means we must find a machete to free her from the foliage!
: No. It means she still has a lot of fighting left to do if she’s going to beat her illness.
: But she will beat it, yes?
: I...haven’t really talked to her about it at length, but she definitely seemed less...fatalistic than when I talked to her last. Which I can only assume is good.
: Does the Yumi know yet?
: That’s...a good question.
: The Yumi should know. Aunt Yuki was very worried about her.
: So much so that she made me her honorary mothermom. But I feel as if I am doing a bad job as I have not been able to find her yet.
: Uh...give me a minute, Kaori. I’m going to call her and make sure she’s not being eaten alive by misery anymore.
: Okay, but you may need to do it very loudly as this is a large city and she may not be nearby.
: I think I’ll be fine, thanks.
I tap on Yumi’s name in my phone, half-excited to break the good news to her and half-worried that she’s just going to blow me off upon hearing it as I still don’t really know how she’s processing-
: Hello?
Monopo- sorry. Holding that thought.
: Hey. Are you alone right now?
: Hah...I kissed you on the cheek one time and now you’re calling me for phone sex? Fuck off, dude.
: I’m calling you about your mom, actually. And before you start freaking out thinking I’m delivering bad news, I’m-
: I’ve heard. That rich family’s taking care of her now. That why you’re calling?
: Oh, good. You already knew. Kaori didn’t, so I wasn’t sure if-
: Fuckin’ Touka practically kidnapped me the other day to take me to her mansion. Yuki gave me the rundown there.
: How does that make you feel?
: What, you my guidance counselor now?
: I mean...kind of?
: Heh...yeah, guess you are.
: I, uhh...
: I feel good. Still kinda pissed that she didn’t tell me, but...I guess I might’a jumped the gun or something like that.
: You said Kaori doesn’t know? She actually cares?
: She may or may not have opened a lemonade stand to try and raise money for her. And I may or may not be there right now.
: She did what? Seriously?
: Well, technically, it’s a lemon assistance stand. But the goal is the same.
: The fuck’s a lemon assistance stand?
: Why not come down to the urban district and see for yourself? She’s apparently been trying to get in touch with you.
: Hah...I don’t know, Sensei. She ain’t...the same girl I knew growin’ up. Doesn’t even remember me.
: Just come down here. I know you’re not busy.
: Fucker, I’ve got a job now. I ain’t just free all the time anymore.
: True, but I know Noriko’s schedule and she’s at work right now. So chances are, you’re free.
: The fuck you memorizin’ her schedule for? Stop that. It’s gross.
: Sending you an address. See you soon, Yumi.
: Wait! I don’t know if-
I hang up the phone and send Yumi my approximate location, figuring there’s a solid 90%% chance she’ll show up as she’s secretly a very family-oriented girl.
And a girl who, weirdly enough, I think will make a great mother one day if there’s ever anyone unfortunate enough to impregnate her and incur the wrath of the Yakuza.
It’ll probably be me, won’t it?

Whatever. I don’t want to think about that right now. I just want these two to become friends again so the entire Yamaguchi tribe can tackle Yuki’s cancer together and go see the sea turtles hatch one day.
But the thought of that is too wholesome, so I forcibly wash it down with the idea of them returning to their hotel afterward and having the weirdest, hottest foursome ever with me.
I’m so good at ruining emotional moments when I’m not meticulously crafting them, aren’t I?
: You are a very pretty girl.
: Um...thank you?
: I did not expect you to be taller than me. I am the older one. I am supposed to be the tall girl.
: Yeah, that’s weird for me too. You were always like twice my size back when we were kids.
: So it is true that you knew me before I was me? And that this is not an elaborate prank at the hands of Yukiburger?
: Yuki...burger?
: It’s best to just not question any of the odd things she says if you can understand the general gist of her sentences.
: Got it...and yeah. I knew you before the...accident happened. Your parents would bring you over and just throw you in with me since there weren’t any other kids around.
: Can’t imagine you enjoyed it since you’re several years older, but...you were always nice to me and I, like...looked up to you and stuff.
: Aww...look at you two bonding.
: Go away, douche-fuck! This is supposed to be a private moment!
: What is “douche-fuck?”
: Just one of my many nicknames for him, but that’s beside the point. I, like...I came over here to say thanks and shit. I had no idea you were doin’ this for Yuki.
: Aunt Yuki is the only blood-based family I had until right now. And as your honorary mothermom, I can promise I will make a lemon-assistance stand if you start dying as well.
: I’m gonna try not to, if that’s cool. Dying ain’t really my thing.
: It was almost mine until I was brought back to life.
: Yeah, what the fuck happened with that? We all thought you were dead. So you showin’ up again was, like...what the fuck?
: I can not remember much apart from the abundance of juice and the seas of white. Those are my earliest memories.
: But I am sad to learn that you have so many of me that I cannot share. I apologize if this makes you hate me, but I would like to like you again.
: I don’t...hate you, Kaori. It’s just...this is weird as shit. Like...goin’ from no family to...havin’ a mom again to...finding out she’s dying...and then she’s not...and now I have a cousin?
: I just...ain’t really the type to let people in easily. And with you bein’ basically a brand new person, I’m like...I don’t know. Shit’s movin’ so fast all of a sudden.
: That small creature over there with the special eyes is Nao-chan! She is my daughterbug! I found her in an alleyway with Friendburger during a treasure hunt!
: You...found her in a...
: I have many jobs and many interests, but furry creatures and other sorts of animals are number one!
: I keep a friendship journal where I write down important facts about the people I like the most! My favorite color is green! And I don’t eat canteloupe because it sounds too much like “antelope!”
: What is happening right now?
: I want to learn how to ride a skateboard and I accidentally became Internet famous by posting pictures of my underwear on the Instant gram! It was very embarrassing!
: Your turn!
: My turn to what? What are we doing?
: If I tell you all of the things there are to know about me, we will no longer be strangers! We will be friends!
: And I want to learn about you! All there is to know! For we must start somewhere in order for things to get better! Why not here?
: Then, uhh...I like junk food and...throwing shit and...I fuckin’ hate crying so I want to stop playing this game.
: It’s so cute watching you grow feelings.
: Yeah, wish I could say the same about you, douche-fuck!
: Douche-fuck!
: Yumi, please don’t corrupt her any more than I have. Kaori doesn’t need to learn words like-
A tug on my sleeve drags my attention elsewhere...
: Oh, Nao. Did you finish handing out your fliers?
: Well, I don’t see any issue in you re-joining the conversation now that the depressing part is over and your “family” is expanding.
: What?
: Uhh, Kaori? Some help here? I still have trouble understanding Nao without her notebook.
: Nao-chan says we should commemorate this reunion with a celebration of some type!
: Yeah, uh...I ain’t really the celebratin’ type. Kinda like my privacy if you know what I mean.
: Then what if there was somewhere we could celebrate in private? With all of the trash food you could ever desire?
: It will be my treat as I have earned extra money from lemon assistance that Aunt Yuki no longer requires!
: Yeah, uhh...I’d feel bad makin’ you pay when I just scored $10,000 the other day.
: You actually got that money? I didn’t think that was ever going to happen.
: Yeah, neither did I. Which is why I waltzed right into the trap of gettin’ lured to that damn manor to talk to my mom.
: Is your relationship with Yukiburger troubled, Yumiburger? She always speaks so lovingly of you!
: Aaaah I don’t give a shit how she speaks! Just point me in the direction of the food! I’m tired of all this emotional bullshit!
: Lead the way, Nao-chan! We will follow- wait. Friend, where are you going?
: Huh? Is this not a family reunion? I kind of figured the three of you would want to spend some time alone.
: Yeah, see you later Sensei. Thanks for calling, I guess. ‘Til next time.
: Man, I could have sworn things were finally changing with us.
: Yeah, maybe wait until somebody actually dies, doucheburger.
: Doucheburger!
: Hah...
Nao grabs hold of my sleeve once more and starts pulling me toward the other two on the way to...wherever it is we’re going.
